name: Lickitung
description: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

name: Nickit
description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Palkia
description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Omastar
description: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

name: Helioptile
description: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

name: Shinx
description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Sandile
description: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.

name: Palpitoad
description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, the can make wave in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Hippowdon
description: Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across. It has enough power to completely crush a car.

name: Eevee
description: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

name: Seadra
description: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Bronzor
description: There are researchers who believe this Pokémon reflected like a mirror in the distant past.

name: Aromatisse
description: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

name: Golurk
description: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

name: Centiskorch
description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Landorus
description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Kricketune
description: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Arctibax
description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Floette
description: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

name: Sizzlipede
description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Tauros
description: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Paldean Wooper
description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Hisuian Qwilfish
description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Wobbuffet
description: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

name: Swadloon
description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Litten
description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Magnemite
description: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

name: Caterpie
description: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.

name: Sinistea
description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Crustle
description: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

name: Hydreigon
description: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Jigglypuff
description: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Magnezone
description: As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems to be receiving signals of unknown origin, while transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

name: Fan Rotom
description: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.

name: Shinx
description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Ferroseed
description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Latias
description: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Vanillish
description: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Slowpoke
description: Although it knows how to fish, no other intelligent behavior has been detected in it.

name: Nidorina
description: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.

name: Deoxys
description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

name: Budew
description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

name: Froakie
description: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Garchomp
description: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.

name: Pumpkaboo
description: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Luxray
description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Mr. Mime
description: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.

name: Pelipper
description: Gathering food is the work of young males. They store food in their capacious beaks and carry it back to others waiting in the nest.

name: Shinx
description: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.

name: Persian
description: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

name: Fearow
description: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land or rest.

name: Slugma
description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Emolga
description: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.

name: Dusclops
description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Aron
description: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Minccino
description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Pidgeotto
description: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

name: Jigglypuff
description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Mudsdale
description: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: Steelix
description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Sinistea
description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Moltres
description: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

name: Rhydon
description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Foongus
description: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

name: Whimsicott
description: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

name: Watchog
description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Vulpix
description: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Machop
description: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

name: Chimchar
description: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Masquerain
description: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Phantump
description: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.

name: Mareep
description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

name: Comfey
description: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

name: Venusaur
description: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Wobbuffet
description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Noivern
description: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

name: Litleo
description: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Lapras
description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Krokorok
description: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

name: Erika's Weepinbell
description: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Palkia
description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: Slowpoke
description: A sweet sap leaks from its tail’s tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

name: Sudowoodo
description: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

name: Dragonair
description: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.

name: Amaura
description: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

name: Torkoal
description: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.

name: Starly
description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Shining Raichu
description: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.

name: Inkay
description: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

name: Hariyama
description: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

name: Hitmonlee
description: Its legs can stretch double. First-time foes are startled by its extensible reach.

name: Sandshrew
description: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.

name: Furfrou
description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Trumbeak
description: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of call and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.

name: Charmander
description: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

name: Tarountula
description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

name: Machop
description: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.

name: Weepinbell
description: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

name: Exeggcute
description: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

name: Clamperl
description: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.

name: Abomasnow
description: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."

name: Zorua
description: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.

name: Crobat
description: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

name: Zubat
description: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

name: Swellow
description: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.

name: Gothitelle
description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Zoroark
description: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Snom
description: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.

name: Team Rocket's Murkrow
description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Simipour
description: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Tinkaton
description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

name: Dunsparce
description: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

name: Linoone
description: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

name: Beautifly
description: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.

name: Grimer
description: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Quagsire
description: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

name: Wigglytuff
description: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

name: Krookodile
description: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

name: Tynamo
description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Jynx
description: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Noivern
description: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Riolu
description: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Rookidee
description: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

name: Flareon
description: Inhaled air is heated in the flame sac in its body to an intense fire over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Bidoof
description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Staraptor
description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Muk
description: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

name: Shinx
description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Vaporeon
description: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Chatot
description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.

name: Sizzlipede
description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Krabby
description: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are broken in battle.

name: Probopass
description: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Glimmora
description: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.

name: Bidoof
description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Shelmet
description: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Charmander
description: Many people find it cute and try to hold it, only to be burned by its tail.

name: Helioptile
description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Bronzong
description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Koffing
description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Tynamo
description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
